notes.title: v1.08 Tank panel update and more tweaks.
notes.content:
[b]v1.08 Tank panel update and more tweaks.[/b]

[list]
[*]Rework:  Reworked the tank info panel, graphical and code rework.
[*] Added: Can now use the scroll wheel to zoom in the unlock tree.
[*] Fix: Fish displayed the wrong gender when in the vault.
[*] Fix: Fixed a bug not displaying Russian names in the list view.
[*] Fix: Fixed some shop tooltip text bugs.
[*] Rework: Game will switch to auto mode while in the unlock tree. (Fish wont age your browsing the unlock tree)
[*] Fix: Fixed some translation texts in the unlock tree.
[*] Fix: Fixed item slot minimizing when opening the unlock tree
[/list]

notes.title: v1.07 Auto/Idle
notes.content:
[b]v1.07 Auto/Idle [/b]

[list]
[*] Feature: Added auto mode, Fish wont age or require feeding. But will still swim and interact. (The auto button is located near the time controls)
[*] Added: I've support for some different aspect ratios (will require feedback as difficult to fully test)
[*] Fix: Fish now show actual space used in the shop
[*] Optimization: A lot of work has gone in behind the code to increase performance and remove performance spikes.
[*] Fix: When deleting tank objects the menu stays open.
[*] Rework: Rework tank decorations, looking to simplify adding future additions! The old system was quite convoluted and made adding content more difficult than it needs to be!
[*] Rework: Re build the vault panel with new Ui and code.
[*] Added: The fishes sex to the vault items.
[*] Fix: Fixed a bug with using the vault that would break the game.
[*] Fix: Power usage wasn't translated.
[*] Fix: Tooltip would go off screen in the unlock tree.
[*] Added: the ability to click unlock instead of holding.
[*] Rework: Rework the unlock tooltips increase scaling to help with some translations issues.
[*] Fix: Wrong text on object deletion!
[*] Fix: some translation issues on list headings!
[*] Fix: Saving and loading eggs added!
[*] Fix: Dead plants wasn't saving, causing confusion for players when plants where disappearing!
[/list]

notes.title: v1.06 Power Update
notes.content:
[b]v1.06 Power Update[/b]

[list]
[*] Rework: Large scale refactor of the games code / architecture. (Reworking old code and centralising assets/data to help with future content updates.) 
[*] Rework: UI updated the shop panel, will be working on other panels in future to match the new designs.
[*] Added: Power panel and costs with a light timer and power usages.
[*] Rework: tutorial restructure and added the option to skip. (again looking to clean up old code/structure to help future patches).
[*] Rework: Tweaked fish sell price and unlock costs. (Looking at slowly tweaking the games difficulty.)
[/list]
